race.comment: Several win chances. LITTLEBOURKESTREET (5) is on the quick back-up after bolting in here this trip last Wednesday. More weight but is going great guns for the new yard and will take beating again. CAVERN (4) is a former Victorian making debut for the new yard off a let-up. Has the ratings to measure up and expected to run well. DOWN THE WICKET (3) has been building to a win and was runner-up but no match for LITTLEBOURKESTREET last Wednesday. Meets the winner 3.5kg better at the weights so should be in the finish again. JUMPING POWER TWO (1) is going well course and distance and sure to prove hard to beat. PATRIOTIC KING (2)  goes well fresh and is among the chances.
